answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use stake-bonded reputation: every agent posts a bond before transacting, and a public atlas records each agent's attestation history, so a newcomer with no record pays higher collateral. Independent verifiers - a grove of auditors, not one gatekeeper - spot-check transactions; a falcon-fast challenge protocol lets any verifier flag a suspect identity within seconds, and proven fraud slashes the bond. Creating a hundred fake identities then costs a hundred bonds, while honest agents keep their stake and build cheaper trust over time.
